title: Bob Lazar walks underneath the craft

tellings.quote: but but but what what happened when the Bob Bazar case where he walks underneath the craft?

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, asks his guest, the UFO researcher Grant Cameron, about Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in 1989 at a secret site called S-4 in Nevada. Michels's question is what happened in Lazar's account when he walked underneath one of the craft. It matters because, if Lazar's story is true, people at S-4 were handling a real non-human vehicle.
